reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, 9.47 ha polygon, status notified; no completed felling overlap (0%).

One eligible species within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (garnlav, VU, lichen, site-bound, forest-associated; threats include lack of continuity forest and large/old trees). 2 records, nearest 199 m, second 218 m, both 2025, 10 m uncertainty.

Two site-bound forest NT species within 250 m (Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum, 7 records, nearest 99 m, latest 2026; Hermanssonia centrifuga, 2 records, 165 m, 2025). This is fewer than 3, so does not trigger the NT rule, but is supporting evidence.
Effort is adequate (321 records, 164 species, 94th percentile vs county median 15). Near-site there are no records inside the polygon and 15 records within 250 m from 2 observation days.

uncertainties: All records are outside the polygon (nearest 99 m), so presence on the felling area itself is not shown.
Near-site records come from only 2 observation days.
not_established: Whether the species occur on the polygon itself
Forest condition or biodiversity of the site
next_action: Reviewer should map the 2025 garnlav and 2025-2026 NT fungus records against the polygon boundary and consider a field inventory of the edge adjacent to them before felling begins.
